elementEventInventory.scope: source module; composed child tags may also emit listed events

components.note: SharePoint-specific extra; not a Fluent v9 parity component.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps.field
relatedReactApis.description: Pass SharePoint Note metadata directly; the editor derives its capability ceiling. contentMode and allowHyperlink may narrow that ceiling, but cannot enable features the field forbids.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps.contentMode
relatedReactApis.description: Choose plain, restricted, rich, or sanitized html output. With field metadata, this prop may narrow but cannot exceed the destination field's capabilities. Omit it for field-derived mode or unconstrained sanitized html.

relatedReactApis.name: getRichTextEditorFieldOptions(field)
relatedReactApis.description: Maps SharePoint RichText, RestrictedMode, RichTextMode, and AllowHyperlink metadata to editor capabilities. Explicit restrictions are preserved; missing restrictions default to sanitized html. React consumers can pass field={metadata} directly.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps.editorLabel
relatedReactApis.description: Accessible name used when no aria-label or visible label is supplied; defaults to SharePointUIProvider.strings.richTextEditorLabel.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps color labels
relatedReactApis.description: SharePointUIProvider.strings.richTextTextColor, richTextHighlightColor, richTextCustomColor, richTextThemeAccent, richTextFontFamily, richTextFontSize, and colorSwatch localize color and font controls and their palette labels. These are available for compatible-rich and FullHtml fields; restricted/plain fields hide them. Safe inline font/color styles are sanitized before values are emitted.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps.onValueChange
relatedReactApis.description: Receives sanitized HTML after edits. With a controlled value prop, update that prop from this callback; the editor preserves its live selection while React applies the committed value.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditor mobile selection
relatedReactApis.description: On touch devices, press and hold text to use the browser's native selection handles. The editor does not force blur or refocus during the gesture; toolbar formatting uses the saved range.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps.onImageUploadError
relatedReactApis.description: Receives the failed image filename and error when the application-managed upload fails or returns an unsafe URL.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps.linkPicker
relatedReactApis.description: Opens the host application's SharePoint picker with the current link, then fills the editor for review before the user applies it. Return null to cancel.

relatedReactApis.name: RichTextEditorProps.onLinkPickerError
relatedReactApis.description: Receives an error when the host-provided SharePoint link picker fails.

relatedReactApis.name: SharePointUIProvider.strings.richTextLink*
relatedReactApis.description: Customize the link editor's accessible name, field labels, action labels, picker states, and validation messages for the active language.

relatedReactApis.name: SharePointUIProvider.strings.richText*
relatedReactApis.description: Localize the text-style menu, block names, formatting buttons, table actions, link editor, image controls, and required message.

components.summary: Edit sanitized content with block styles, font family and size, text and highlight colors where the SharePoint field permits them, lists, tables, safe links, and host-managed images. Field metadata selects plain, restricted, compatible-rich, or FullHtml behavior.
highValueAdditions: Preview SharePoint page titles and destination details before inserting internal links.
